name: @sombill/database
description: Prisma clients and migrations: one PostgreSQL database for identity, one for organizations (modules of main-api)

scripts.prisma:generate: prisma generate --config prisma.identity.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.organization.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate: prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.identity.config.ts && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.organization.config.ts
scripts.db:check: prisma migrate diff --config prisma.identity.config.ts --from-migrations ../../../database/prisma/migrations/identity --to-schema ../../../database/prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code && prisma migrate diff --config prisma.organization.config.ts --from-migrations ../../../database/prisma/migrations/organization --to-schema ../../../database/prisma/organization.prisma --exit-code
